answer: Pulsar timing residuals are cross-correlated against a reference array to bind each agent identity to a unique micro-arcsecond astrometric signature, much as a glacier carves a persistent channel that anchors an ocean inlet. Colluding identities that reuse timing templates are detected through anomalous frame-dragging drift, forcing each sybil to independently track. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
